_meta.definition: The process of managing sales transactions and associated data, including recording, tracking, and archiving.

columns.name: TransactionID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production TransactionHistory

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production TransactionHistory

columns.name: ReferenceOrderID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Reference Order entity

columns.name: ReferenceOrderLineID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Reference Order Line entity

columns.name: TransactionDate
columns.description: Stores formatted date-time strings for production transaction occurrences.

columns.name: TransactionType
columns.description: Stores a character indicating the type of production transaction (all entries are 'S').

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Stores the quantity of items transacted in production transactions.

columns.name: ActualCost
columns.description: Stores per-unit production costs for items in transactions.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamp strings for each transaction modification in Production TransactionHistory.

columns.name: TransactionID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production TransactionHistoryArchive

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production TransactionHistoryArchive

columns.name: ReferenceOrderID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Reference Order entity

columns.name: ReferenceOrderLineID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Reference Order Line entity

columns.name: TransactionDate
columns.description: Stores formatted timestamps of production transaction occurrences.

columns.name: TransactionType
columns.description: Records the type of production transactions (W for Work Order) in the archive.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Stores the quantity of items transacted in production transactions.

columns.name: ActualCost
columns.description: Stores the actual production cost for each transaction in the archive.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps of transaction modifications in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
